published_source: Printed Table 2, Panel B ('Controlling for customer-year FE'), column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2023.04090.pdf, p. 3157), read Nov 4 2026: Supplier Law -0.023** with the t-statistic (-1.76) in parentheses (no SE printed, so published_se = null), Observations 3,212, R2 0.485, supplier FEs and customer x year FEs, no controls; equals the authors' code output -0.023497 (SE 0.013314, t -1.765; fixest with the authors' exact FE and singletons dropped as reghdfe does; the authors' esttab csv prints b = -0.023, t = -1.76), N 3,212, to the printed decimals. Earlier: Tables/output_2b.csv (authors' esttab output), Table 2 Panel B column 1: b = -0.023*, t = -1.76, N = 3,212, R2 0.485. SE implied from the printed t-statistic. fixest with the authors' exact FE reproduces b = -0.023497, SE = 0.013314 (t = -1.765) once singletons are dropped as reghdfe does.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output -0.023497 (0.013314), N 3,212, equals printed Table 2 Panel B column (1) -0.023 (t -1.76; no SE printed), N 3,212, to the printed decimals; authors' FE reproduced in fixest; run_spec uses pair FE instead of supplier FE, see notes; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Authors: reghdfe sp_arS s_law, absorb(s_id year#c_id) vce(cluster s_incorp) on finalSEC.dta (pair-year, 1993-2010, 5,405 rows; use==1 everywhere). Outcome = pair-level trade credit / pair-level sales. Treatment s_law = 1 if an anti-recharacterization law is in force in the supplier's state of incorporation; a deterministic s_incorp x year function, absorbing, no switch-offs. gvar g_law = state-level first treated year as coded in the data (1998, 2002, 2003 [Delaware, 676 of 969 suppliers], 2005, 2006, 2008; NA for 27 never-adopting states); D = 1{year >= g_law} equals s_law on every row. DEVIATION (flagged): the published column uses SUPPLIER fixed effects (a group FE coarser than the pair) plus customer-by-year FE on pair-level rows. run_spec.R can only interact xt_vars with time at the level of id_var, and c_id is time-invariant only within the pair, so following the lead's instruction the unit is the pair (cs_id) with c_id as xt: FE = pair + customer-by-year. This retains the paper's customer-year comparison but replaces supplier FE with pair FE. fixest TWFE under this FE = -0.032512 (SE 0.018819, N 5,405) vs the published -0.023497 under supplier FE; supplier+year FE without the customer interaction gives -0.031276 (run as sensitivity spec T2B_c1_sp_arS_supplierunit). Clusters: 34 states; Delaware holds 3,595 of 5,405 rows, so the leverage screen is expected to fail. Singletons: reghdfe drops 2,193 singleton rows (N 3,212); the pipeline keeps them (N 5,405), the point estimate is unchanged but the clustered SE small-sample factor differs (0.01672 vs 0.01331 under the authors' FE). CSA in run_spec uses composition-fixed pair cells (unbalanced panel) and ignores xt; BJS (did2s) uses pair + year + year^c_id in the first stage.
